digest.en: A U.S. jury found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets, while leaked data shows over 300 Russians killed supporting Mali’s junta. Meanwhile, armed men hold hostages at a supermarket in Colombia’s top tourist destination. These events highlight shifting security dynamics across three continents.
digest.hi: आज रूस के यामाल नेवियास्क तेल रिफाइनरी पर यूक्रेन की ड्रोन हमला हुआ, दो कर्मचारियों की मौत और कई घायल हुए। पुतिन ने जवाबी कार्रवाई की घोषणा की, जबकि यूरोपीय संघ ने तेल कीमतों में गिरावट की चेतावनी दी।

articles.title: Contrer la menace du Jnim sur les centres urbains du Sahel
articles.summary: Al-Qaeda in the Sahel has intensified attacks on urban centers. Military responses risk worsening the human toll. Negotiated solutions may offer a less damaging path forward for the region. Ces dernières années, la branche d’al-Qaeda au Sahel a multiplié les assauts contre les villes de la région. Chercher à vaincre les jihadistes par les armes ne ferait qu’alourdir un bilan humain déjà considérable.

articles.summary: The Security Council is weighing how AI and drones reshape warfare. Guterres noted these technologies are fuelling record conflict levels. When the UN was founded in 1945, computers, the internet and satellites were the stuff of science fiction. Today, artificial intelligence (AI) is already assisting in targeting, drones are reshaping warfare and disinformation is spreading in unprecedented ways, fuelling record levels of conflict.

articles.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO less than two weeks after his resignation. Shares surged roughly thirty percent in New York trading. articles.title: Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development, UN warns
articles.summary: The UN deputy chief warned that the Gaza war has undone seventy-seven years of human development. Palestinians face violence and displacement despite the October 2025 ceasefire. He urged renewed international support for a two-state solution to the conflict. The UN deputy chief urged renewed international support for a two-State solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict on Monday, warning that Palestinians continue to face violence, displacement and dire living conditions despite the October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza.

articles.title: UN chief urges talks on global AI safety framework, warns of historic shift in power
articles.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres called for talks on a multilateral AI safety framework. He warned that artificial intelligence is driving the biggest transfer of power in human history. Member States must begin discussions to manage these emerging technological risks. UN Secretary-General António Guterres on Monday called on Member States to begin discussions on a multilateral framework for managing the risks of artificial intelligence (AI), warning that the technology is driving “the biggest transfer of power in the history of humankind”.

articles.title: Ukraine Strikes Russian Warship, Cargo Vessel Off Libya's Coast
articles.summary: Ukraine struck a Russian corvette and a cargo ship near Benghazi, Libya. Seven Ukrainian-made sea drones executed the operation. The corvette carried a Ka-27 helicopter. The cargo vessel allegedly transported weapons across the Mediterranean Sea. Kyiv confirmed the details of the attack. Ukraine says that it struck a Russian corvette carrying a Ka-27 helicopter near the port of Benghazi, Libya, as well as a cargo ship allegedly used to transport weapons across the Mediterranean Sea.

articles.title: Why Taiwanese firms resist leaving China, even as tensions rise
articles.summary: Acer and Asus are relocating production lines from Thailand and Vietnam back to mainland China. When Stan Shih, the founder of electronics company Acer, arrived in the southern Chinese city of Shenzhen to represent Taiwan at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit recently, his company was already in the news.

articles.title: NATO-Like Guarantees For Ukraine? US Envoy Signals Possibility, But Questions Remain
articles.summary: Jared Kushner said Donald Trump might offer Ukraine security guarantees modeled on NATO commitments. This possibility hinges on reducing the risk of another Russian invasion. The envoy signaled this potential shift on November 22. Questions remain regarding the specific terms and conditions of such an arrangement. US President Donald Trump may consider offering Ukraine security guarantees modeled on NATO's collective-defense commitments if he is convinced that the risk of another Russian invasion has been sufficiently reduced, special envoy Jared Kushner said on November 22.

articles.title: Rescuers Search For Victims After Russia Attacks Apartment Building Near Kyiv

articles.title: COP31 ends without climate pact as UN chief warns there is ‘no ambiguity in the science’
articles.summary: COP31 concluded without a binding climate agreement. Negotiators failed to resolve disputes over fossil fuel phaseouts.
